description: This Java source file defines the BOMHelper class, providing static utility methods for handling product bills of materials, including calculating maximum depth, detecting duplicate ancestors, and creating production runs for shipments.

classes.name: BOMHelper
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for managing product BOMs, including depth calculation, ancestor duplication detection, and shipment production run creation.

methods.name: getMaxDepth
methods.description: Recursively calculates the maximum depth (low level code) of a product in BOM hierarchy based on parent relationships.

methods.name: searchDuplicatedAncestor
methods.description: Finds a duplicate ancestor node in BOM to prevent loops when adding components.

methods.name: createProductionRunsForShipment
methods.description: Creates production runs for a shipment by invoking a service, handling errors, and logging.
